headline: How long does it take to find a soulmate the second time?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x age band. NO MAN EXISTS YET — she asks WHEN or WHETHER. Must not fall through to decode-him.
🔴 THE AGE BAND LIVES IN THE AD SET, NEVER IN THE COPY. No age, no number, no life-stage.
🔴 NO DURATION, forward or back — 'not much longer' is a LENGTH, and a length is not a date.
⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6; the male figure is described in beats 1-2 and retired there.
⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

🔴 A LENGTH IS BANNED AND SHE IS ASKING FOR ONE. The read says no length was ever set, which is true and is the only answer available.
⚠ 'The second time' implies a first that ended. The read never asks about it and never rules on it.

readback.1 would a person say this: Yes. 'And it's stayed like that' is plain speech.
readback.2 is every noun real: The same four objects laid out again, the calm face, the fresh flower — all on the card.
readback.3 anything she could catch me getting wr: No. Beat 4 says nobody has come and she has had nothing to go on. Neither is a count or a life-fact.
readback.4 does the symbol prove the line at a gl: Yes. The same four things laid out ready proves 'you can do it again' with nothing to explain.

a: You turned the Magician. You reached without knowing, and you took the one with nothing put away.
Look at his table. Every tool is out, and the table stands on open grass.
You asked how long it takes the second time. The thing I keep looking at is the table, still laid out.
And yet nobody has come. And what you want from me is how long.
Something sits in front of this, between you and it. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed you which was which, and yours was the card still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. There are green leaves on it.
You asked how long it takes the second time. Living wood, with a rope on it.
Still, nobody has come. And the number you want is the whole of your question.
Something shows up at the moment things would settle. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs gave nothing away, and you chose the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. That's the whole of what he carries.
You asked how long it takes the second time. A start already made — that's what this card shows me.
But nobody has come. And you're still the one asking for a number.
Whatever holds this holds it evenly, with no give in it. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
